title: 🌧 Rainy Day in Lumiose City 🗼 1 Hour Chill Pokémon Legends: Z-A Music + Rain Ambience 🎧 Study Aid
description:
Hey chill trainers! Let’s chill on a rainy day in Lumiose City ☔ Enjoy the view of the Prism Tower from Hotel Z's rooftop while the rain falls peacefully over the city 🌧 The perfect ambience as background noise to help you focus as you study, work, or relax ☕

--------------------------------------------------------------

☕ Welcome to Chill Poke Hour - a chill cross of Pokemon, music, and ambience ☕ 
Support the channel by subscribing & turning on notifications 🔔

--------------------------------------------------------------

Use headphones for best experience 🎧
Music: Pokemon Legends: Z-A Theme 
Ambience: Rain + Pokemon 

--------------------------------------------------------------

💌 Hi chill trainers! I started this channel to document my favorite Pokemon moments and enjoy Pokemon vibes anytime throughout my day. I hope this video is helpful whether you’re studying, working, or trying to relax. If you did enjoy this, please SHARE it with a friend or family member who you think would like it and also LIKE and subscribe for more videos like this in the future!

☕ If you’d like to further support the channel you can send me a coffee/tea on Ko-Fi: https://ko-fi.com/chillcrossinghour 

Thanks for watching & supporting the channel! I hope you have a wonderful rest of your day 😊

🤍 Momo
